paragraphs.text: The Mississippi Department of Transportation is seeking bids for safety improvements on MS 336 from US 278 to Apostolic Circle in Pontotoc County, with the project included in its Oct. 27, 2026, bid letting.
The work includes audible edge stripe, raised pavement markers and replacement curve and intersection warning signs, according to MDOT’s advertised contract and proposed project schedule.

The project appears as Call 14 in the bid notice, under Federal Aid Project HRRR-1336-58(003), project number 110210301. Oct. 27 is the bid-letting date; the listing does not establish when construction will begin.
